datecheck: DATE CHECK — Left out as Friday 20 November's news: Wall Street's fall into a correction, the Russian barrage that hit Kyiv's bridges, the missile that landed in Poland, the UK–EU deal and Cyclone Akvan's landfall. Older still: Voyager 1's light-day (18 Nov). Not confirmed when drawn, so not shown: BepiColombo in Mercury orbit, a final COP31 text.

features.body: COP31 missed its Friday close. A draft with no mention of fossil fuels split nearly 200 countries; a third text is promised. (AFP, Al Jazeera)
features.head: Climate summit runs into Saturday with no deal

features.body: The Saudi-led coalition said three were destroyed over Riyadh before dawn and two over Jizan, a day after it bombed Hodeidah port. (AFP, Dawn)

features.body: The deep quake near Carhuamayo was felt in Lima and along the coast. Eight were hurt, 128 homes hit; no deaths, no tsunami risk. (USGS, Indeci)
features.head: Magnitude 6.7 earthquake shakes central Peru
